claims.claim_text: On May 30, 2025 Moog amended/restated its loan agreement to include a $250M term loan; in 2025 used $100M on share buybacks and paid $36M dividends; SECT and ESPP active. Insider/equity activity around amended-debt + buyback + dividend events.
claims.subject: Moog Inc.
claims.source_quote: On May 30, 2025, we amended and restated our loan agreement to include a $250 million term loan ... Net cash used by financing activities in 2025 included a use of cash of $100 million for shares under the repurchase program ... and $36 million for dividend payments.

claims.claim_text: Net sales to Moog's five largest customers represented approximately 31% of 2025 sales; aerospace and defense OEM customers collectively represented 61% of 2025 sales. Major customers include tier-1 large U.S. Government contractors / system integrators.

claims.source_quote: Net sales to our five largest customers represented approximately 31% of our 2025 sales ... Aerospace and defense OEM customers collectively represented 61% of 2025 sales.
